# ElfUI

> ElfUI is a themeable design system for Vue 3 and Nuxt 4, built on Reka UI and Tailwind CSS v4, with three themes: elf (pure black with violet accents, rounded), nova (gold on obsidian, sharp corners) and elfwood (light, green on white).

ElfUI is source-distributed and published on npm as `@xouyi/elfui` (currently 0.5.4). Install with `bun add @xouyi/elfui` or `bunx @xouyi/elfui@latest init`. All Vue components use the `Elf` prefix. Use Bun for every command.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/getting-started/introduction): what ElfUI is and what it includes
- [Installation (Nuxt)](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/getting-started/installation-nuxt): install in a Nuxt 4 app
- [Installation (Vite + Vue)](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/getting-started/installation-vite): Vite and Vue setup
- [Theming](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/getting-started/theming): tokens, data-theme, creating a theme
- [CLI](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/getting-started/cli): bunx @xouyi/elfui init, add, list, diff
- [useElfTheme](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/getting-started/use-elf-theme): switch themes in one line: Nuxt module options or createElfTheme() plus useElfTheme() (SSR-safe, persisted, no flash)
- [Registry](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/getting-started/registry): copy components with bunx @xouyi/elfui add (or the shadcn-vue CLI)
- [Button](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/button): Triggers an action. Renders a native button; use as-child to render a link or other element.
- [Input](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/input): Single-line text input with v-model. A native input: all native attributes fall through.
- [Badge](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/badge): Small pill for status and labels. Static text unless rendered as a link or button with as-child.
- [Card](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/card): Container for grouped content, composed from parts.
- [Dialog](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/dialog): Accessible modal dialog on Reka UI: focus trap, Escape to close, focus restore.
- [Tabs](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/tabs): Switch between related views. Roving focus and arrow-key navigation on Reka UI.
- [VisuallyHidden](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/visually-hidden): Hides content visually while keeping it in the accessibility tree. Use it for icon-button names, hidden labels and table captions.
- [Label](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/label): Accessible label for a form control. Renders a native label; clicking it focuses or toggles the control.
- [Separator](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/separator): Horizontal or vertical divider. Decorative by default; set decorative to false to expose role=separator.
- [Kbd](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/kbd): Keyboard key hint. A native kbd element; ElfKbdGroup keeps the keys of one shortcut together.
- [Spinner](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/spinner): Indeterminate busy indicator. An SVG ring in a role=status region with a visually hidden label; inherits the text color.
- [Skeleton](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/skeleton): Placeholder block shown while content loads. Decorative (aria-hidden); size and shape come from classes.
- [Textarea](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/textarea): Multi-line text input with v-model and optional auto-grow. A native textarea: all native attributes fall through.
- [Field](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/field): Form row: label, one control, description and error wired through id, for, aria-describedby and aria-invalid. Wrap the control in ElfFieldControl; works with ElfInput, ElfTextarea and native controls.
- [Checkbox](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/checkbox): Binary or indeterminate selection control built on Reka UI Checkbox. v-model is boolean | 'indeterminate'. Pair it with ElfLabel; inside ElfField wrap it in ElfFieldControl.
- [RadioGroup](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/radio-group): Mutually exclusive options built on Reka UI RadioGroup. ElfRadioGroup holds the value (v-model); each ElfRadioGroupItem is one option. Pair every item with ElfLabel; inside ElfField wrap the group in ElfFieldControl.
- [Switch](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/switch): On/off setting that applies immediately, built on Reka UI Switch. A role=switch button with v-model (boolean). Pair it with ElfLabel; use a Checkbox for choices submitted later.
- [Select](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/select): Dropdown to choose one value, built on Reka UI Select. Compose ElfSelect (v-model) > ElfSelectTrigger + ElfSelectValue, ElfSelectContent > ElfSelectItem (optionally in ElfSelectGroup with ElfSelectLabel and ElfSelectSeparator). Inside ElfField wrap only the trigger in ElfFieldControl.
- [Theme Switcher](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/theme-switcher): Ready-made control to switch themes: ElfThemeSwitcher with variant select (default), buttons (segmented radio group) or toggle (one icon button that cycles). It uses useElfTheme(), so it offers the themes configured in the Nuxt module options or createElfTheme(), shows the active one and persists the choice. No v-model.
- [Alert](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/alert): Static message with an icon, a title and a description. Variants: default, destructive, success, warning. Composed from native elements (no Reka primitive): ElfAlert with ElfAlertTitle and ElfAlertDescription.
- [Progress](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/progress): Progress bar built on Reka UI Progress (role=progressbar). Determinate with v-model (0..max) or indeterminate with a null value. Always give it a name with label, aria-label or aria-labelledby.
- [Avatar](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/avatar): Person or team image with an initials fallback, built on Reka UI Avatar. ElfAvatar (size) contains ElfAvatarImage and ElfAvatarFallback; ElfAvatarGroup overlaps several.
- [GradientText](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/gradient-text): Inline gradient text (bg-clip-text) on a span by default. Real, selectable text; presets follow the theme and pass 4.5:1 on every theme background.
- [Tooltip](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/tooltip): Short non-interactive hint on hover or keyboard focus, built on Reka UI Tooltip. Compose ElfTooltip > ElfTooltipTrigger (as-child around a button) + ElfTooltipContent. Wrap related tooltips in one ElfTooltipProvider to share the open delay.
- [Popover](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/popover): Anchored interactive panel, built on Reka UI Popover. Compose ElfPopover > ElfPopoverTrigger (as-child around a button) + ElfPopoverContent; ElfPopoverClose closes it, ElfPopoverAnchor anchors it elsewhere. Non-modal by default; modal traps focus.
- [HoverCard](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/hover-card): Rich preview shown when a link is hovered or focused, built on Reka UI HoverCard. Compose ElfHoverCard > ElfHoverCardTrigger (as-child around a real link) + ElfHoverCardContent. Supplementary only: never opens on touch and is not announced.
- [DropdownMenu](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/dropdown-menu): Action menu opened from a button, built on Reka UI DropdownMenu. Compose ElfDropdownMenu > ElfDropdownMenuTrigger (as-child around a button) + ElfDropdownMenuContent > items. Items: ElfDropdownMenuItem (@select), ElfDropdownMenuCheckboxItem (v-model), ElfDropdownMenuRadioGroup (v-model) with ElfDropdownMenuRadioItem, ElfDropdownMenuSub with SubTrigger and SubContent; ElfDropdownMenuLabel, Group, Separator and Shortcut (put ElfKbd inside) structure it.
- [ContextMenu](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/context-menu): Menu for an area opened by right-click, long-press, Shift+F10 or the ContextMenu key, built on Reka UI ContextMenu. Same parts and styles as ElfDropdownMenu: ElfContextMenu > ElfContextMenuTrigger (as-child around a focusable element) + ElfContextMenuContent > ElfContextMenuItem, CheckboxItem, RadioGroup/RadioItem, Label, Group, Separator, Shortcut, Sub/SubTrigger/SubContent. Never the only way to reach an action.
- [ScrollArea](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/scroll-area): Scrolling container with styled scrollbars, built on Reka UI ScrollArea. Native scrolling is kept; the viewport is keyboard focusable. Give ElfScrollArea a height or width (class) and a label.
- [AlertDialog](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/alert-dialog): Modal that demands a decision (destructive confirmation), built on Reka UI AlertDialog. Role alertdialog: focus starts on Cancel, Escape cancels, an outside click never dismisses it.
- [Sheet](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/sheet): Edge-anchored modal panel on Reka UI Dialog: side sheets for forms and navigation, and a bottom sheet for mobile. Same focus trap, Escape and focus restore as ElfDialog; an outside click closes it.
- [Toast](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/toast): Transient notifications. Mount one ElfToaster per app and call useToast() (or import toast) from anywhere: toast(message, options), toast.success/warning/error, toast.promise, toast.update, toast.dismiss. Built on the Reka UI Toast viewport and manager; the queue is a module singleton that is a no-op on the server.
- [Collapsible](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/collapsible): A single show and hide region with an animated height, built on Reka UI Collapsible. ElfCollapsibleTrigger toggles ElfCollapsibleContent.
- [Accordion](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/accordion): Stacked collapsible sections on Reka UI Accordion. ElfAccordion (type single or multiple) contains ElfAccordionItem (value) with an ElfAccordionTrigger heading button and an ElfAccordionContent region.
- [Breadcrumb](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/breadcrumb): Hierarchical location trail composed from native elements: a labelled nav with an ordered list. Collapse long trails with ElfBreadcrumbEllipsis inside an ElfDropdownMenu.
- [Pagination](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/pagination): Page navigation on Reka UI Pagination: a nav with a list of page buttons, ellipsis, first/previous/next/last, plus ElfSimplePagination for a previous/next bar. Render pages from the items slot of ElfPaginationContent.
- [Toggle](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/toggle): Pressable on/off button (ElfToggle) and a group of them (ElfToggleGroup with ElfToggleGroupItem) in single or multiple mode, built on Reka UI Toggle and ToggleGroup. Use it for filter chips, sort selectors and formatting buttons.
- [AspectRatio](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/aspect-ratio): Fixed-ratio frame for media, built on Reka UI AspectRatio. Fills the width of its parent and keeps width / height equal to ratio; an img or video child is cropped to cover.
- [Table](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/table): Semantic styled table on a native table. ElfTable (required caption) wraps ElfTableHeader, ElfTableBody, ElfTableFooter, ElfTableRow, ElfTableHead (th, scope col) and ElfTableCell (td). It scrolls sideways inside its container; stackOnMobile turns rows into cards below sm. The parts are designed so a data table can be composed on them: put a sort button in ElfTableHead and set its sort prop (aria-sort).
- [Empty](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/empty): Empty state: ElfEmpty > ElfEmptyHeader (ElfEmptyMedia, ElfEmptyTitle, ElfEmptyDescription) + ElfEmptyContent for the action. For empty lists, tables and search with no results.
- [StatCard](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/stat-card): KPI tile: label, value, hint and trend. A group named by its label. loading shows skeletons and sets aria-busy. To make the card a link, put ElfStatCardLink (as-child around a router link) in the label slot; it stretches over the whole card.
- [NavigationMenu](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/navigation-menu): Top-level site navigation (a nav landmark) with flyout panels, built on Reka UI NavigationMenu. Compose ElfNavigationMenu > ElfNavigationMenuList > ElfNavigationMenuItem > ElfNavigationMenuTrigger + ElfNavigationMenuContent (links inside) or a top-level ElfNavigationMenuLink variant="trigger". Panels share one animated viewport by default (viewport=false puts each under its item). Use as-child on ElfNavigationMenuLink to render a router link.
- [Menubar](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/menubar): Desktop-style horizontal menu bar (File, Edit, View) built on Reka UI Menubar. Same item parts and styles as ElfDropdownMenu: ElfMenubar > ElfMenubarMenu > ElfMenubarTrigger + ElfMenubarContent > ElfMenubarItem, CheckboxItem, RadioGroup/RadioItem, Label, Group, Separator, Shortcut, Sub/SubTrigger/SubContent. For application commands, not for site navigation (use ElfNavigationMenu).
- [Sidebar](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/sidebar): Collapsible app navigation composed from Sheet, Tooltip, Collapsible, Separator and ScrollArea. Wrap the layout in ElfSidebarProvider, put ElfSidebar (header, content, footer) beside ElfSidebarInset (the main area) and add an ElfSidebarTrigger. On desktop it collapses to an icon rail (collapsible="icon") or slides away (offcanvas); below 768px it becomes an off-canvas sheet. useSidebar() exposes state, open, setOpen, openMobile, setOpenMobile, isMobile and toggleSidebar. Ctrl/Cmd+B toggles it.
- [Stepper](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/stepper): Multi-step progress and wizard header on Reka UI Stepper. ElfStepper contains ElfStepperItem (step, 1-based) with an ElfStepperTrigger holding an ElfStepperIndicator and an ElfStepperTitle, plus an ElfStepperSeparator between steps. It renders no step content.
- [DataTable](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/docs/components/data-table): Data table composed on ElfTable with TanStack Table Vue: sorting, a global search, column visibility, row selection, pagination, skeleton loading rows and an empty state, in client or server-driven mode. Define columns with createDataTableColumnHelper<Row>() (no TanStack import needed), pass columns, data and rowKey, and bind the state with v-model:sorting, selection, columnVisibility, pagination and globalFilter.

## Reference

- [Documentation site](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/): guides and a page per component with live previews, API tables and accessibility notes
- [Repository](https://github.com/xouyi/elfUI): source, issues, releases
- [Example Nuxt app](https://github.com/xouyi/elfUI/tree/main/examples/nuxt-demo): realistic consumer app
- [Registry item index](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/r/registry.json): shadcn-vue registry (copy components into your project)
- [llms-full.txt](https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/llms-full.txt): complete reference for AI assistants

## Rules

- Use ElfUI components (ElfButton, ElfInput, ElfBadge, ElfCard, ElfDialog, ElfTabs) instead of hand-rolling buttons, inputs, badges, cards, dialogs or tabs.
- Choose appearance with props (variant, size), not custom classes or inline styles.
- Style with theme tokens (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, border-border), never hard-coded colors (no #hex, no bg-violet-500).
- Use text-destructive-text for error messages and required markers; bg-destructive is a fill and is too dark for text.
- Use text-success-text and text-warning-text for status text and icons; bg-success and bg-warning are fills.
- Themes decide light or dark (elf and nova are dark, elfwood is light): never add dark: variants or hard-coded colors.
- To let users switch themes, configure it once (Nuxt module options `themes` and `persist`, or `app.use(createElfTheme({ themes }))` in Vue) and call `useElfTheme()` with no arguments; never write data-theme or cookies by hand.
- Do not override border radius with arbitrary values; radii derive from the theme (nova is sharp, 0px).
- Components are auto-imported in Nuxt with the Elf prefix; outside Nuxt import them from "@xouyi/elfui".
- Always label inputs (label for= or aria-label) and give icon-only buttons an aria-label.
- Dialogs need a title and description; tabs lists need an aria-label.
- Keep exactly one primary (default variant) button per view; use destructive only for irreversible actions.
- Install from npm (`bun add @xouyi/elfui`, or `bunx @xouyi/elfui@latest init` to set up a project); typescript 5 or 6 (not 7) must be installed in the consumer project.
- Use Bun for all package commands (bun add, bun run, bunx), never npm, pnpm or yarn.
